title: Small mobs
description: This data pack will make all mobs in the game small, and you twice as big.
body: This data pack will make all mobs in the game small, and you twice as big. Additionally, mobs will have some stats reduced due to their size, while you, due to your larger size, will have increased stats. Have you ever dreamed of trampling mobs? Now you can, because with this data pack, you'll have that opportunity! You'll be able to trample mobs, dealing damage, and even kill them!
